description: This file is a shell script for controlling system indicator LEDs during different boot and operational states on an OpenWrt-based device. It defines functions to set LED states based on system events like startup, failsafe mode, and upgrade processes.

methods.name: set_led_state
methods.description: Sets the LED state based on the input parameter, controlling LED blinking or off states for various boot and failover scenarios.

methods.name: set_state
methods.description: Determines whether to update the LED states based on current system variables.
